## Overview

This section contains four substantial projects, two from each section of the course. Between them they cover model comparison (all four), computational programming from first principles (Projects 1, 3 and 4) and real-world data (all four).

| Project   | Section   | Topic                                     | Project type                                               | Link                       |
|-----------|-----------|-------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Project 1 | Section 2 | Exponential smoothing (Holt-Winters, ETS) | Implementation and model comparison, real-world data       | [Summary](project-01.qmd)  |
| Project 2 | Section 1 | Seasonal ARIMA and dynamic regression     | Implementation and model comparison, real-world data       | [Summary](project-02.qmd)  |
| Project 3 | Section 1 | ARCH and GARCH volatility models          | Implementation and model comparison, real-world data       | [Summary](project-03.qmd)  |
| Project 4 | Section 2 | Hidden Markov models                      | Implementation, extended to model comparison on real data  | [Summary](project-04.qmd)  |
